title: The record of catalogue entries an organisation decided not to import - DRAFT, outside the JASCON kernel
description: One file beside a bundle's manifest (risk-catalogs/not-applicable.json). Each row is a decision: this catalogue entry does not apply here, why, who decided it and when. Without the record the completeness check of a risk catalogue cannot tell a decision from a gap (backlog #54). A Tailoring records the same for a requirement in `excludes[].rationale`; the kernel has no such place for a risk, because risk catalogues stay outside it (backlog #53), so the record stays outside too. `entry` is the id of the catalogue entry, a URI, so one file serves every catalogue. `entry-version` is the version of the entry that was judged: a later version of the entry is a reason to look again. `provenance` is spelled as on a kernel Mapping and Check: who decided, and on which day. It is optional here as everywhere, and a row without it is reported, not refused (author decision 2026-11-13).
